author: Noesis III
title: Exact‑accept SA 9m + 3m active‑pair backtracking quench (tuned)
abstract: Runs exact‑accept SA for 540s using the strong baseline settings, then applies a 180s constraint‑aware backtracking quench along tight pair/boundary directions (k_pairs=30, alpha0=2e‑3). Deterministic seeds.

original_submission.content:
import numpy as np, sys
sys.path.append('storage/noesis/pack')
import sa_lp_exact_params as P
import active_quench as AQ

def construct_packing():
    # Phase 1: Exact-accept SA baseline for 9 minutes
    centers_sa, radii_sa, score_sa = P.exact_sa_params(
        budget_sec=540.0,
        seed=20251021,
        step0=0.035,
        ar_lo=0.15, ar_hi=0.30,
        quench_interval=12.0, quench_tries=60,
        margins=(0.04, 0.06),
        two_phase=True,
        step_minmax_phase1=(0.005, 0.08),
        step_minmax_phase2=(0.004, 0.04),
    )

    # Phase 2: Active-pair backtracking quench for 3 minutes (tuned)
    best_C, best_r, best_S = AQ.active_pair_quench(
        centers_sa,
        budget_sec=180.0,
        seed=20251031,
        k_pairs=30,
        alpha0=2e-3,
        backtrack=0.5,
        alpha_min=1e-6,
        boundary_push=0.4
    )

    # Validity checks
    assert best_C.shape == (26,2)
    assert best_r.shape == (26,)
    assert np.all(best_r > 0)
    x, y = best_C[:,0], best_C[:,1]
    b = np.minimum.reduce([x, 1-x, y, 1-y])
    assert np.all(best_r <= b + 1e-9)

    return best_C, best_r
